主要内容: On March 14, 2019, Freshstart Venture Capital Corp., a wholly-owned subsidiary of Medallion Financial Corp., entered into amendments to the Loan Agreement and Note. The amendments extended the payment date under the Loan Agreement, effective January 25, 2017, and the Note, effective March 1, 2017. These amendments were made while additional negotiations for further amendments were ongoing. The amendments are attached as exhibits and incorporated by reference. The changes relate to the terms of the Loan Agreement and Note between FVC and the U.S. Small Business Administration.
